data.title: 诀 · 细雨武陵长街撑伞同行
data.action: 撑着深色长柄伞在细雨石板街上停步侧望
data.lighting: 湿润青灰雨光与街边暖黄檐灯倒影
data.description: 暮色里落起细密小雨，石板路映着沿街商铺暖黄的灯影。身着雾灰长风衣的李织烟把深色油布伞微微往你这边倾斜半分，修长手指搭在伞柄上，回眸时眼底映着细碎水光——「再往前走两条街有家老汤馆，去避避雨吧。」
data.promptProse: Pausing on a rain-slicked cobblestone avenue at dusk beneath a dark umbrella, Arcane wears a tailored mist-grey trench coat and turns slightly toward the viewer with quiet warmth as shopfront lanterns glow behind her.
data.animaCaption: She stands on the wet evening street holding a dark umbrella tilted slightly in the rain, looking calmly toward the viewer.
